plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft, and manage email.

plugins.name: Navan

plugins.name: Phishing inbox scan

plugins.name: Flight check-in
plugins.description: Once-daily scan for flights whose check-in opens in ~24h; spawn a one-shot at open+1m, else sleep until tomorrow.
